name: scos-memory-fabric
description: Connects Claude Desktop to the SCOS Memory Fabric's mcp-gateway service over HTTPS.
long_description: Bridges Claude Desktop (which only launches local stdio MCP servers) to the SCOS mcp-gateway's remote Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Exposes scos_recall, scos_status, scos_explain, scos_user_model, scos_memory_graph, scos_correct and scos_forget against the same backend Claude Code connects to via docs/agent-connection-guide.md. Requires network reachability to the configured gateway URL (Tailscale by default) and the same tenant/bearer credentials issued for this fleet.

gateway_url.title: mcp-gateway URL
gateway_url.description: Base MCP endpoint for the SCOS mcp-gateway service. Defaults to the rabuntu fleet deployment.

bearer_token.title: SCOS bearer token
bearer_token.description: Value of SCOS_HERMES_BEARER_TOKEN from ~/.hermes/scos.env on this machine, or your own issued service token.
